body.statement: Under the Fourier convention \(\widehat g(t)=\int_{\mathbb R}e^{itx}g(x)\,dx\) on \(L^1(\mathbb R)\cap L^2(\mathbb R)\), extended continuously to \(L^2(\mathbb R)\), every square-integrable \(g\) satisfies \(\|g\|_2^2=(2\pi)^{-1}\|\widehat g\|_2^2\).

source.locator: proof of Lemma 1, first display after the proof heading
source.verbatim_statement: We start by deriving an upper bound using Parseval’s identity and Fubini’s theorem.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the primary Statistica Sinica PDF A16n112.pdf, p. 200, proof of Lemma 1, lines immediately preceding and including the first display; that display begins with an L2 error equality carrying the factor (2π)^−1 under the paper’s exp(itY) Fourier convention.
